title: What ad mediation and attribution setup for a first mobile launch?
body: A first mobile game with ads and paid user acquisition needs a mediation layer and an attribution provider, and each adds SDKs, reporting and privacy decisions on iOS. What did you pick, and how many networks did you connect at launch?

AppLovin's [MAX getting-started guide](https://support.applovin.com/en/max/getting-started/) says MAX supports many networks across bidding and traditional connections, and that unsupported networks can be mediated through a custom SDK connection that AppLovin cannot troubleshoot. The [AppsFlyer pricing page](https://www.appsflyer.com/pricing/) says users can start for free with no credit card required.
Share how you decided between waterfall and bidding, how you handled SKAdNetwork on iOS and whether the extra SDKs affected build size or crash rates.
